resource.name: email-service
resource.description: Internal transactional email service that sends emails on behalf of consuming projects, exposed via a REST API.

config.description: Base URL of the internal email service API.

resource.consumptionInstructions: Whenever a project needs to send an email, use this resource rather than integrating a new email provider. Call the internal email API at its base URL using the operations described in its OpenAPI contract. No authentication or API key is required — the endpoint is reachable directly with no credentials.
